title: Correct five mislabeled accepted data-item concepts
description:
Correct ground truth (corpus skill), not scanner alignment.

Five KDATAP-a0e80b Tier A rows remain `accepted` with a suffix-derived concept that contradicts pinned source and `expected.labels`. Leave a0e80b in awaiting-review; this is a separate correction pass.

| id | wrong leaf / key | source truth |
| --- | --- | --- |
| redmine-email-address | `address` (street) | email (`URI::MailTo::EMAIL_REGEXP`) |
| directus-user-password | `password` | argon2 hash / `password_verifier` |
| ghost-staff-password-item | `password` | hashed credential |
| pocketbase-password-hash | `password` | bcrypt verifier |
| strapi-user-password | `password` | bcrypt hash |

Do:

- Demote these five to `needs_adjudication` so they are not accepted gold with the wrong concept.
- Fix or withhold the `candidate` leaf so it does not propose the contradicted suffix mapping. Ontology only from `patterns/personal-data-concept-map.yaml`. If `password_verifier` is not a scored leaf, withhold a leaf and keep adjudication.
- Do not run `scan()` or use detector output.
- Do not rewrite other data-item rows, flows, or components.
- Do not write `review_state: accepted`.
- Record before/after in `pass.md`.

Parent decision (b0d5e2): labels are expected to expose scanner defects. This slice only fixes annotation truth.
